comment: QUESTS.md B3, PIP-3 The Contest at the Sign of the Bell. Mrs Harbottle's set piece first; with Piper, the entry - Ballad (Not Sad), one trope - and the two rival acts come in. Without Piper the contest waits. The contest: three acts scored, then Piper's set, which is a fight (troop 41) whose damage type is heckling; the thrush gets a three from Miss Quayle and wins by one point. Second place, the rosette only Piper can wear, her story. Afterwards for everybody; the rivals gone home. P1: Piper's set is fought by Piper alone - the party to the bench by the door and back after both branches, troop 41 sized off her - and a second contest is lost on purpose to prove the lose branch.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; window._mark = () => { window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); window._blushes = $gameVariables.value(7); window._stories = $gameVariables.value(15); window._lines = []; }; window._mark()

steps.comment: Piper, and the panel's own set piece first.

steps.label: before the judges' table, facing Mrs Harbottle

steps.check: window._lines.some(l => l.includes("Miss Quayle gives everything a two."))

steps.label: without her, the panel's own page
entered; the tournament, again: one trope

steps.comment: Piper dismissed: the contest waits for her.
The fight wins itself four seconds in, once the troop has been read (or, with window._autowin_lose, loses itself).
steps.eval: window._autowin = 0; const su = Scene_Battle.prototype.update; Scene_Battle.prototype.update = function () { su.call(this); if (window._autowin !== undefined && ++window._autowin === 240) { const p = $gameParty.battleMembers()[0]; window._troop = [$gameTroop._troopId, $gameTroop.members().map(e => e.enemyId()), $gameParty.battleMembers().map(a => a.actorId())]; window._sized = { p: [p.mhp, p.mmp, p.mat, p.agi, p.mdf], hp: p.hp === p.mhp, e: $gameTroop.members().map(e => [e.mhp, e.atk, e.mat]) }; if (window._autowin_lose) { $gameParty.members().forEach(a => { a.addState(1); a.setHp(0); }); BattleManager.checkBattleEnd(); } else $gameTroop.members().forEach(e => e.addState(1)); } }

steps.label: Piper's set was troop 41, Dray, Moon and the back table, and Piper alone (P1)

steps.check: window._lines.some(l => l.includes("that it is Piper's set."))
steps.label: the rest of you are on the bench by the door

steps.check: (() => { const [mhp, mmp, mat, agi, mdf] = window._sized.p; const ef = 4 * mat + 2 * agi; const h = Math.ceil((0.14 * mhp + mdf) / 2); const [t, dr, mo] = window._sized.e; return [t[0] === Math.floor(3.5 * ef), dr[0] === Math.floor(4 * ef), mo[0] === Math.floor(3.5 * ef), t[1] === h, dr[2] === h, mo[2] === Math.max(1, Math.ceil(0.06 * mmp / 2))]; })()
steps.label: sized to her: patience in Epic Finales, heckling a share of her

steps.check: window._lines.some(l => l.includes("the back table runs out"))

steps.label: second place: the rosette, her story, no second trope

steps.check: window._lines.some(l => l.includes("He has a rosette on, in red silk"))
window._lines.some(l => l.includes("She gave the thrush a three."))

steps.comment: A look at the fight itself, for the record.
steps.eval: window._autowin = undefined; window._party = $gameParty._actors.slice(); $gameParty._actors = [7]; BattleManager.setup(41, false, true); SceneManager.push(Scene_Battle)

steps.comment: P1: the lose branch also puts the party back. The contest again, with the switches set back, lost on purpose: she finishes anyway, rested, the same scores.

steps.label: and the scores are the scores
the party is back, she is on her feet, and nobody else was in it
